title: Diagnostic logs
switchLabel: Let SPAWN D support collect diagnostic logs
description: While this is on, SPAWN D support can ask one of your machines for its recent SPAWN D log when something goes wrong. The log can contain session IDs, local paths and file errors that may include an IP address. It never has what you type, what your terminals show, or what is in your files. Each log is kept on the SPAWN D server for 7 days, then deleted. Turning this off stops new collections and deletes any logs already collected.
